0022600104.text: The Heat head to Charlotte for their third game of the season at 0-2, sitting fifth in the Southeast and two games back, with Pelle Larsson listed as day-to-day with a finger sprain and a game-time decision. The Hornets are 1-1, third in the Southeast and one game back, but they are without Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee, surgery), while Christian Anderson is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Miami won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, though the most recent meeting went Charlotte's way, a 136-106 Hornets win in Charlotte on March 17, 2026.
